provenance.source: World Squash Federation, Specifications for Squash Courts (document 171128_Court-Specifications, edition dated January 2017, published on worldsquash.sport)
provenance.ref: Appendices 1 to 4 critical dimensions; clauses 4.0x (dimensions), 5.01 to 5.05 (markings), 7 (door), 9.01.02 (clear height), 11.01 (lighting); Appendix 4 (hardball doubles court)

notes: Values were read directly from the WSF specification PDF on 2026-10-25; secondary websites disagree on the service line (1.78 vs 1.83 m) and short line (5.44 vs 5.49 m) and were not used.
Camera planning: WSF 3.03 forbids distracting cameras behind the front or side walls during play; the back wall and ceiling are the practical camera positions.
Court lines (short line, half-court line, service boxes) are the natural calibration targets for mapping image coordinates into this frame.
